item.title: Weekly briefing: the Crimean Bridge war, missiles in Poland, and Iran widens its targets
item.description:
The first weekly edition covers November sixteenth to twenty-third: Ukraine's strikes cut the Crimean Bridge and Russia answers with a barrage of more than a hundred missiles, three of which land in Poland; Trump meets Putin in China; a drone kills eleven in Dymer; Ukraine hits a Russian warship in Libya; the US strikes Qeshm Island as Iran hits Bahrain and Kuwait; the George Washington leaves the Middle East; and the Houthis close in on Aden.

item.title: Ukraine's biggest drone raid hits the Crimean Bridge, three US carriers gather, and the Houthis reach the strait
item.description:

item.title: Up to thirteen hundred prisoners each way, a rising toll in Zaporizhzhia, and Washington denies the Bahrain strike
item.description:
